bio.text: Kalman Yeger is a member of the New York State Assembly representing District 41, having assumed office on January 1, 2025; Yeger is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot on the Republican, Democratic and Conservative lines.
Yeger previously represented District 44 on the New York City Council, beginning in 2018.
Ballotpedia says Yeger earned an undergraduate degree from Touro College and a J.D. from New York Law School, and lists attorney as the profession.
